description: PW Stormwater Management Division Metrics FY24-25 is a dataset listed in City of Encinitas open data portal (datainsights.encinitasca.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Encinitas. This dataset includes key performance metrics for the City of Encinitas Public Works Stormwater Management Division during Fiscal Year 2024-2025. It includes inspection counts, discharge investigations, outfall monitoring, and structural BMP facility performance as part of the City's Clean Water Program. Coverage: Encinitas, California. The portal files it under the category Services. Its tags are public works, beach, bmp, discharge, environment. The table has 2 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Encinitas. The portal shows 2025-08-13 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datainsights-encinitasca-gov-portal.
